source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the index of hydrogen deficiency (PDF 187-188).

blocks.text: Yahan diye gaye do compounds dekhein: 1-hexene aur cyclohexane.

In dono ka molecular formula aik hai (C₆H₁₂) lekin structure (banawat) alag hai, yani yeh isomers hain. In mein aik aur baat bhi milti hai: dono mein saturated alkane (hexane, C₆H₁₄) se do hydrogen atoms kam hain. Yani in mein do hydrogen atoms ki deficiency (kami) hai. Hydrogen ki yeh kami compound ki degree of unsaturation (unsaturation ka darja) batati hai. Index of hydrogen deficiency (IHD) isi unsaturation ka measure (naap) hai. Har do kam hydrogen atoms par compound mein aik degree of unsaturation hoti hai.

blocks.alt: 1-Hexene ka skeletal formula, chhe carbons ki zigzag chain (tedhi zanjeer) jis ke daen sire par double bond hai, 1-Hexene (C6H12); aur aik hexagon (chhe-kona), Cyclohexane (C6H12).
blocks.caption: 1-Hexene aur cyclohexane (29.1 ke shuru mein chhape structures ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.text: Isi liye oopar wale dono compounds ka IHD 1 hai.

blocks.title: Index of hydrogen deficiency (IHD)
blocks.text: Degree of unsaturation (U) ya IHD: compound aur utne hi carbon atoms wale acyclic (bina ring wale) alkane ke darmiyan hydrogen atoms ke pairs (joron) ke number ka farq.

Har double bond ya ring saturated compound ke muqable do hydrogen atoms kam kar deta hai aur aik degree of unsaturation banata hai. Maslan C₄H₆ mein saturated C₄H₁₀ se chaar hydrogen atoms kam hain, is liye is ki do degrees of unsaturation hain (IHD = 2).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Hydrocarbon CₓHᵧ ke liye seedha formula: IHD = (2x + 2 − y) / 2. Maslan C₄H₆: (2 × 4 + 2 − 6) / 2 = 4 / 2 = 2.
